title: LabelFusion-TS: Fusing Large Language Models, Transformer Encoders, and Financial Time Series for Monetary-Policy Stance Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.11753v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial text is produced and interpreted within a market environment, yet financial text classifiers almost always receive text alone. We study whether financial time series are useful as an additional input on the task of classifying sentences from Federal Reserve communication as hawkish, dovish, or neutral. Our system, \lfts{}, extends the \lf{} architecture with this modality: a small voting network combines three independently trained components, a fine-tuned RoBERTa encoder, a prompted large language model (LLM), and a fused ensemble of time-series transformers over the market series of the months preceding publication. Because only about a thousand annotated sentences are available for training, the RoBERTa encoder is first pre-trained on sentences annotated automatically by the LLM and only then fine-tuned on the human labels. Trained on Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) communication up to 2015 and evaluated on 2015--2022,

translated_title: LabelFusion-TS：融合大型语言模型、Transformer编码器与金融时间序列的货币政策立场分类
translated_abstract: 金融文本是在市场环境中产生和解读的，但金融文本分类器几乎总是仅接收文本。我们研究了在美联储沟通中，将句子分类为鹰派、鸽派或中性的任务中，金融时间序列是否作为额外输入有用。我们的系统\lfts{}扩展了\l f{}架构，引入这一模态：一个小型投票网络结合了三个独立训练的组件，包括一个微调的RoBERTa编码器、一个提示式大型语言模型（LLM），以及一个融合的时间序列Transformer集成，这些Transformer处理发布前几个月的市场序列。由于训练仅有约一千条带注释的句子，RoBERTa编码器首先在由LLM自动注释的句子上进行预训练，然后在人工标签上进行微调。该系统在截至2015年的联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）沟通上训练，并在2015至2022年间进行评估。
tldr: 该论文提出LabelFusion-TS系统，通过融合RoBERTa编码器、大型语言模型和时间序列Transformer，利用金融时间序列作为额外输入，有效提升了美联储沟通中货币政策立场（鹰派/鸽派/中性）的分类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LabelFusion-TS, which integrates a RoBERTa encoder, a large language model, and time-series transformers to leverage financial time series as auxiliary input, enhancing the classification of monetary-policy stance (hawkish/dovish/neutral) in Federal Reserve communications.
